name: Legacy Woodworking & Design | Las Vegas | Built-ins, Butcher Block, CNC
old_description: We design and build custom furniture and built-ins designed to transform spaces and impress your clients and guests.
about:
Legacy Woodworking & Design operates from Henderson, Nevada, where partners Ken Beck and Eric Carr lead a custom woodworking shop focused on built-in furniture and architectural millwork.

The shop offers a full-service woodworking operation that includes CNC machining, laser engraving and cutting, and traditional cabinetmaking. Services span design consultation, field measurements, 3D rendering, shop fabrication, and delivery with installation. Projects range from residential built-in offices, entertainment centers, bookcases, floating shelves, and butcher block countertops to commercial reception counters, accent walls, conference tables, and custom desks.

Clients include homeowners, interior designers, general contractors, marketing firms, exposition companies, and restaurant or bar operators seeking custom serving trays, flight holders, and presentation boards. The company also supports on-demand manufacturing for businesses needing prototypes or short production runs.

Legacy Woodworking & Design emphasizes a partner-driven approach, handling every detail from initial consultation through final installation. The team highlights its ability to combine digital fabrication with hands-on craftsmanship to deliver one-of-a-kind pieces on schedule.
